workflows.name: deep-read-staged
workflows.purpose: read the whole text of every staged source, part by part - claims and limits with their pages, terms, and any reasoning stance a text teaches, staged as a lens (V1's lens scan, on the clerk channel)

workflows.name: draft-reflection
workflows.purpose: draft a short reflection grounded only in a week's own gathered tasks, activity and desk (W3 weekly-review, step 4)

workflows.name: flag-sensitive
workflows.purpose: mark one staged source for a person's review as possibly dual-use

workflows.name: gather-activity
workflows.purpose: what was read and written across every session - or one pursuit's, given a project - since a cutoff (W3 weekly-review, step 2)

workflows.name: gather-agenda
workflows.purpose: every open, dated task across the vault - or one pursuit's, given a project - bucketed by when it falls (W3 weekly-review, step 1)

workflows.name: gather-desk
workflows.purpose: a pursuit's current working set (W3 weekly-review, step 3)

workflows.name: ingest-cited
workflows.purpose: record an external research report's cited links as evidence, then fetch and stage every cited arXiv or DOI paper (V1's ingest_resolved_links, declared)

workflows.name: review-conversation
workflows.purpose: find catalogued sources relevant to a snapshot of a conversation; writes nothing

workflows.name: review-due
workflows.purpose: open one parked learn session per concept whose review task is due, framed for the review, for the person to resume from Sessions (Co-work Roadmap §2 W4, §4 D4)

workflows.name: review-item
workflows.purpose: draft the unframed Bottom Line and run the sensitivity check for one staged source

workflows.name: review-staged
workflows.purpose: draft the unframed Bottom Line and run the sensitivity check for every staged source that has none yet (V1's draft_staging_promotions, declared)

workflows.name: run-queue
workflows.purpose: take what is waiting in the intake queue through fetch, evidence, description and staging

workflows.name: sync-vault
workflows.purpose: keep the vault's ignore rules current, commit what changed, and push it

pipelines.name: clear-enrichment-backlog
pipelines.purpose: run the intake queue, then route each fetched source to review, a sensitivity flag, or nothing further

pipelines.name: weekly-review
pipelines.purpose: gather a pursuit's tasks, cross-session activity and desk, then draft a reflection for the person to review (Co-work Roadmap §2, W3)

macros.name: inspect_map_source
macros.purpose: Inspect a source then refresh its map

macros.name: search_and_judge
macros.purpose: Search then inspect the chosen source

macros.name: intake_to_stage
macros.purpose: Ingest one reference into reviewed staging

macros.name: evidence_to_claim_check
macros.purpose: Read a pinned source file before a claim check

macros.name: review_staged_candidate
macros.purpose: Review a staged candidate, then make the selected decision

macros.name: source_pages_to_claim_check
macros.purpose: Read a located generated section, then check the original PDF pages
